title: You Can Be 100% Right on Direction and Still Lose Money
text: You need to be right pretty fast. This is how you start folding all of these pieces together to figure out what kind of structure you prefer. The way that you express your idea has a huge implication on what your P&L curve will look like over the life cycle. This is giving you a scenario where it's the same idea. You think the thing is going to go up, but this is expressed in three different terms and it's showing you your sensitivities to different things. So, you'll notice that if you're trading the really near-term term, you're really gamma sensitive and really theta sensitive and not very Vega sensitive and so on. You think a stock is going to go up, but so then you say, "Well, great. I want more gamma. I want more convexity, so I'm going to come really close in time, but what's the trade-off?" Theta.
